purpose: Stable semantic contracts for parameterized first-party motion assets. Designed for LottieFiles Motion Tokens / dotLottie authoring while keeping factual values and identity controlled by the active Design System and QA.

contracts.rule: data.* values must come from QA/production data, never from generative pixels or demo defaults
day/destination values remain deterministic and validated; geometry may be abstract unless official geography is verified
official/legal/factual copy must be injected from approved text; AI may not silently rewrite a locked title

productionRules: Motion Tokens make an asset reusable; they do not make its contents factual or brand-approved.
Brand token values are resolved from the active Design System at production time.
Factual text/value tokens are resolved from QA/verified production data at production time.
Demo/default token values must be visibly marked and rejected by production QA.
Do not expose official logo geometry as a generative/morphable motion token.
Do not use tokenized movement to distort official marks or waves.
A dotLottie/Motion Token asset is not production-ready until its adapter and deterministic render test pass in this repository.
